mapper.select:
select m.PORTFOLIO_ID , m.IND_ID , m.PORTFOLIO_LEVEL , m.START_DATE , m.END_DATE , n.IND_NAME , n.IND_TYPE , n.EXPR , n.SUP_FREQUENCY , n.WARN_COND , n.APPROVE_COND , n.FOUL_COND , n.TIME_POINT , y.PORTFOLIO_ID as PORTFOLIO_DTL_ID , y.PTL_BAG_ID from ( SELECT A1.PORTFOLIO_ID,A1.IND_ID,A1.START_DATE,A1.END_DATE,A1.PORTFOLIO_LEVEL FROM RSK_PORTFOLIO_INDICATOR A1 left join PTL_PORTFOLIO A2 on A1.PORTFOLIO_ID=A2.PORTFOLIO_ID where (case when A1.PORTFOLIO_LEVEL=#{isEnabled} then A2.VDATE else to_date('1900-01-01','yyyy-MM-dd') end) <=to_date('${valDate}','yyyy-MM-dd') and (case when A1.PORTFOLIO_LEVEL=#{isEnabled} then A2.MDATE else to_date('2099-12-31','yyyy-MM-dd') end) >to_date('${valDate}','yyyy-MM-dd') ) m inner join RSK_ISUP_INDICATOR n on m.IND_ID=n.IND_ID and n.IS_ENABLED=#{isEnabled} and n.TIME_POINT like CONCAT(CONCAT('%',#{timePoint}),'%')
and n.SUP_FREQUENCY LIKE CONCAT('%', CONCAT(#{supFrequency}, '%'))
left join (select t1.PORTFOLIO_ID,t1.PTL_BAG_ID from RSK_PORTFOLIO_PACKAGE_DTL t1 inner join PTL_PORTFOLIO t2 on t1.PORTFOLIO_ID=t2.PORTFOLIO_ID and t2.MDATE>to_date('${valDate}','yyyy-MM-dd') ) y on y.PTL_BAG_ID=m.PORTFOLIO_ID
( m.PORTFOLIO_ID in ( select #{portfolioCode} from dual union select PTL_BAG_ID from RSK_PORTFOLIO_PACKAGE_DTL where PORTFOLIO_ID=#{portfolioCode}))
and m.START_DATE <= to_date('${valDate}','yyyy-MM-dd') AND (case when m.END_DATE is null then to_date('2999-01-01','yyyy-MM-dd') else m.END_DATE end) > to_date('${valDate}','yyyy-MM-dd')
select PARA_CODE paraCode ,PARA_GRANULARITY paraGranularity ,PARA_DISPLAY_TYPE paraDisplayType ,CONTENT from RSK_ISUP_INDICATOR_PARA_DTL where PARA_CODE=#{code} and PARA_GRANULARITY=#{granularity}
select max(SUP_DATE) from RSK_ISUP_POINT_VAL where PORTFOLIO_ID = #{portfolioId} and IND_ID = #{indId}
select count(1) as count from PTL_PORTFOLIO

select PRT_BAG_ID as prtBagId, IND_ID as indId, CONDITION_ITEM as conditionItem, CONTROL_TYPE as controlType, VALUE_STR as valueStr, VALUE_END as valueEnd, DATE_STR as dateStr, DATE_END as dateEnd, DATE_UNIT_STR as dateUnitStr, DATE_UNIT_END as dateUnitEnd from RSK_INDIVID_CONDITION_VIEW

select t.CDATE , t.PORTFOLIO_ID as portfolioId, t.TDY_ASSET_NETVALUE as tdyAssetNetvalue from PTL_PORTFOLIO_VALUATION t INNER JOIN ( SELECT MAX(CDATE) CDATE,PORTFOLIO_ID FROM PTL_PORTFOLIO_VALUATION WHERE CDATE <=to_date('${valDate}','yyyy-MM-dd') GROUP BY PORTFOLIO_ID ) m ON t.PORTFOLIO_ID=m.PORTFOLIO_ID AND t.CDATE=m.CDATE

/** 高频开放**/ select n.PORTFOLIO_ID as finprodId,to_date('${valDate}','yyyy-MM-dd') AS OPEN_DATE_STR,to_date('${valDate}','yyyy-MM-dd') AS OPEN_DATE_END, to_date('${valDate}','yyyy-MM-dd') AS OPEN_VDATE,r.OPEN_TYPE from PTL_PORTFOLIO m INNER JOIN PA_PTL_PORTFOLIO n ON m.PORTFOLIO_ID=n.PORTFOLIO_ID AND n.OPEN_TYPE='02' INNER JOIN FIN_CASH_INFO n ON n.FINPROD_ID = 'F16_' || m.PORTFOLIO_ID AND n.CASH_TYPE_1 = '01' AND n.CASH_TYPE_2 = 'C01' INNER JOIN FIN_OPEN_RULE r ON r.CASH_ID = n.CASH_ID AND r.OPEN_MODE = '02' /** 定期或周期开放（区间最近一次）**/ UNION SELECT PORTFOLIO_ID finprodId,OPEN_DATE_STR,OPEN_DATE_END,OPEN_VDATE,OPEN_TYPE FROM ( SELECT m.PORTFOLIO_ID,y.OPEN_DATE_STR,y.OPEN_DATE_END,y.OPEN_VDATE,y.OPEN_TYPE,rank() over(PARTITION BY m.PORTFOLIO_ID,y.OPEN_TYPE ORDER BY y.OPEN_VDATE asc) AS rowno from PTL_PORTFOLIO m INNER JOIN FIN_CASH_INFO n ON n.FINPROD_ID='F16_'||m.PORTFOLIO_ID AND n.CASH_TYPE_1='01' AND n.CASH_TYPE_2='C01' INNER JOIN FIN_OPEN_PLAN y ON y.CASH_ID=n.CASH_ID INNER JOIN PA_PTL_PORTFOLIO s on m.PORTFOLIO_ID=s.PORTFOLIO_ID AND s.OPEN_TYPE='02' WHERE y.OPEN_VDATE>=to_date('${valDate}','yyyy-MM-dd') ORDER BY y.OPEN_VDATE ASC ) WHERE rowno=1
select UNITE_ID as uniteId, PRT_BAG_ID as prtBagId, IND_ID as indId from RSK_INDIVID_UNITE_VIEW

select DEL_ID delId, PRT_BAG_ID prtBagId, IND_ID indId, START_DATE startDate, END_DATE endDate, FINPROD_ID finprodId from RSK_INDIVID_ASSET_DEL_VIEW
START_DATE <= to_date('${valDate}','yyyy-MM-dd') AND END_DATE >= to_date('${valDate}','yyyy-MM-dd')
select ACTION_TYPE from SYS_WFL_BUSINESS_LIST where SEQ_NO=#{seqNo, jdbcType=VARCHAR}

select INSTITUTION_CODE from DATA_AUTH_NOTIFY_INST WHERE DATA_AUTH_NOTIFY_INST.MODEL_TYPE = '02' and DATA_AUTH_NOTIFY_INST.DATA_TYPE = 'PTL01' and DATA_AUTH_NOTIFY_INST.BUSINESS_ID = #{portfolioId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
